newsitem.title: USA: Owosso sees Q2 sales, pretax earnngs up.
newsitem.headline: Owosso sees Q2 sales, pretax earnngs up.

text.p: Owosso Corp said Friday that it expects to report pretax income of $1.4 million to $1.5 million for its second quarter ended April 27, compared to pretax income of $968,000 the previous second quarter.
Owosso said it expects sales for the quarter to be about $37.6 million, up about 12 percent from the year before.
The company said that second quarter earnings per share look to be about double last year's level, when it reported earnings of $0.05 a share.

"Although Sooner Trailer is not yet where it needs to be, we have seen a recovery in its margins due to improved productivity, and we expect them to continue to increase their margins in the second half of the fiscal year," the company said in a press release.

Owosso said that with the exception of its replacement camshaft bearings business, demand for its products remains healthy going into the third quarter, with booking up over 20 percent, compared to a year ago.
